name: الله
meaning_ar: الاسم الأعظم الذي تفرد به الحق سبحانه وتعالى وهو أصل الأسماء جميعها
meaning_en: The Greatest Name that belongs uniquely to Allah and is the source of all other names

name: الرحمن
meaning_ar: ذو الرحمة الواسعة التي وسعت كل شيء
meaning_en: The Most Merciful whose mercy encompasses all things

name: الرحيم
meaning_ar: ذو الرحمة الواصلة إلى عباده المؤمنين
meaning_en: The Most Compassionate whose mercy reaches His believing servants

name: الملك
meaning_ar: المالك لجميع الأشياء المتصرف فيها بلا منازع
meaning_en: The King who owns all things and controls them without dispute

name: القدوس
meaning_en: The Holy One who is free from all defects and imperfections

name: السلام
meaning_en: The Source of Peace who is free from all flaws and defects

name: المؤمن
meaning_en: The Believer who confirms His messengers by showing miracles through them

name: المهيمن
meaning_en: The Guardian who dominates His creation with power and knowledge

name: العزيز
meaning_en: The Mighty One who cannot be defeated

name: الجبار
meaning_ar: الذي يجبر الخلق على ما يريد
meaning_en: The Compeller who enforces His will upon creation

name: المتكبر
meaning_en: The Supreme who is above the attributes of creation

name: الخالق
meaning_en: The Creator who brings things into existence from nothing

name: البارئ
meaning_ar: الذي خلق الخلق بريئاً من التفاوت
meaning_en: The Maker who creates without any inconsistency

name: المصور
meaning_en: The Fashioner who shapes all beings and arranges them

name: الغفار
meaning_en: The Oft-Forgiving who forgives sins no matter how many

name: القهار
meaning_en: The Dominant who overpowers all His creation

name: الوهاب
meaning_en: The Bestower who gives without compensation

name: الرزاق
meaning_en: The Provider who sustains all His creation

name: الفتاح
meaning_en: The Opener who opens the doors of mercy and sustenance

name: العليم
meaning_en: The All-Knowing who knows everything
